_doctrine: 13-phase Wall Street cycle. Phase is JORDAN'S call (editorial). Until he calls it, phase='Awaiting Jordan's call' and phase_source='awaiting'. Score + trend are facts and always present; phase_suggestion is the auto/brain advisory. next_move is the FORWARD prediction (brain consensus) — where the phase goes next; current phase stays the anchor.

next_move.reasoning: Coil base rate dominates: muted momentum, flat funding, and diverging blowoff factors argue score stays in-band rather than a confirmed breaker up or down.
next_move.brains_agree: partial — both non-aggressive, but analyst is explicit HOLD/CAUTION coil while narrative only supplies flow color without a forward phase
next_move.confirmed_if: F&G holds ~47-58 and 30d momentum stays muted with no funding spike or ETF-flow reversal
next_move.invalidated_if: F&G breaks below ~40 with price/CVD breakdown (toward Anxiety) or momentum and funding re-accelerate with F&G above ~62 (toward Optimism)
